name: Unscroll
subtitle: Instagram without the endless scroll
description:
Instagram without the endless scroll: no Reels, no Explore, no suggested posts — just the people you follow, their stories, and your DMs. Unscroll is Instagram's own website with those taken out, made to feel like an app.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Meta or Instagram.

apps.name: Unscroll
apps.subtitle: Instagram without the endless scroll
apps.localizedDescription:
Instagram without the endless scroll: no Reels, no Explore, no suggested posts — just the people you follow, their stories, and your DMs. Unscroll is Instagram's own website with those taken out, made to feel like an app.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Meta or Instagram.

versions.localizedDescription:
• New messages without Instagram's app: every 15 minutes or so Unscroll checks for chats with unread messages and tells you (Settings → Notifications → Check for new messages; on by itself where Instagram's app isn't installed).
• Save a photo or video sent in a chat: hold it → Save.
• Send in a chat, from any app: share words, a link or photos to Unscroll, pick the chat, and they're in its message box, ready to send.
• Your time (Settings): time spent each day, an optional daily feed limit with a reminder, and Messages only at night.
• Long-press the Unscroll icon → Messages.
• Unscroll 2.0.1: double-tapping a message likes it every time
• Unscroll 2.0.0: smoother, measured on a phone
• Unscroll 1.9.5: a comment you shared opens its post; back from a reel stays in the chat
• Unscroll 1.9.4: a post, reel or comment a friend sends opens when tapped
• Unscroll 1.9.3: Home is the Following feed, not "Suggested for you"
• Unscroll 1.9.2: a story opens without asking "View as …?" first
• Unscroll 1.9.1: the chat's camera no longer sits on "Message..."

• Unscroll 1.9.0: a camera in the chat, and photos from the phone's photo picker
• Unscroll 1.8.13: a message's whole menu, found however Instagram shows it
• Unscroll 1.8.12: holding your own message shows its whole menu, once
• Unscroll 1.8.11: Home is the Following feed again
• Unscroll 1.8.10: over the feed, the keyboard slides the page up instead of shrinking it
• Unscroll 1.8.9: a push to the feed's own address no longer reloads it; a keyboard that closes by itself is reported
• Unscroll 1.8.8: sharing a post, its search keeps the keyboard
• Ignore Kotlin's build state (.kotlin/), and untrack a compiler log committed by mistake
• Unscroll 1.8.7: holding a message shows Instagram's whole menu for it at once
• Unscroll 1.8.6: a chat's reactions open from the bubble only; its notices follow Settings
• Unscroll 1.8.5: a gesture on a sheet or a post opened over a page stays there

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: To take a photo or video for a post, a story or a message.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: To record sound with a video for a post, a story or a message.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: To save a photo you choose to save.
